title: Phrases
summary: Days, months and seasons, used in sentences.

den.sentenceGloss: Monday is the first day of the week.

ponedilok.sentenceGloss: Today is Tuesday, and yesterday was Monday.

chetver.sentenceGloss: Today is Wednesday, and tomorrow will be Thursday.

nedilya.sentenceGloss: Today is Saturday, and tomorrow will be Sunday.

serpni.sentenceGloss: We take our holiday in August.

vzymku.sentenceGloss: It's cold in Kyiv in winter.

navesni.sentenceGloss: I like going for walks in spring.

vlitku.sentenceGloss: We take our holiday in summer.
